current_or_proposed_source: Paralogy to ASNS, gene name, InterPro/Pfam PF00733 partial hit
basis: The carboxylate equivalent to AS-B Glu348 and human ASNS Glu365 is absent in 429/429 vertebrate ASNSD1 orthologs and in 1731/1731 members of the ASNSD1 family (InterPro IPR051857) on an all-taxa scan, versus 376/376 vertebrate ASNS orthologs and 1817/1869 members of the asparagine synthetase family (IPR006426). No neighbouring carboxylate has appeared to compensate: the acidic shell around the position is identical in ASNSD1, human ASNS and AS-B. PMID:20853825 shows beta-aspartyl-AMP formation and asparagine production require a carboxylate at this position. The removal applies family-wide, not to human ASNSD1 alone.
Downstream of GO:0004066. No metabolite, flux or complementation evidence exists for ASNSD1.

go_term: carbon-nitrogen ligase activity acting on glutamine as amido-N-donor
basis: The glutaminase half-reaction machinery is present, but the amido-N acceptor half is broken and no acceptor substrate is known. Assigning the ligase parent implies a complete ligation.

go_term: hydrolase activity, acting on carbon-nitrogen (but not peptide) bonds
recommended_action: flag as unresolved candidate; make-specific only with assay evidence
basis: ASNSD1 retains the class-II GATase fold (GATase domain superposes on AS-B at 1.74 A over 110 CA, mean pLDDT 93.0), the N-terminal Cys nucleophile (MCGICCSV; 438/442 vertebrate orthologs begin Met-Cys) and an intact glutamine-binding pocket (Arg57, Asn76, Glu78, Asp91 at 99-100% conservation). UniProt already annotates Cys2 as an active site for GATase activity. There is no direct glutaminase assay. Counter-evidence: the Met-Cys start is absent in Nematoda (2/56) and Apicomplexa (0/23), so the nucleophile is not a family-wide requirement and this candidate term must not be propagated across the family by orthology.

recommended_action: assign only with IEA-level caution; prefer the specific nucleotide-binding evidence
basis: ASNSD1 324-335 is ILFSGGIDSMVI, the canonical PP-loop with one conservative Leu to Ile; S327/G328/G329/D331/S332 are 100% conserved across 313-398 species. Motif presence predicts binding; no measured affinity exists.

ASDURF, the uORF product of the ASNSD1 transcript, is the PAQosome prefoldin-like subunit. It is a distinct gene product. Annotation carry-over between ASDURF and the ASNSD1 main ORF should be checked explicitly.

recommended_action: candidate for a mouse-based annotation only; do not transfer to human without orthology-qualified evidence
basis: Asnsd1 null mice show progressive degenerative myopathy, sarcopenia and myosteatosis, with maximal expression in skeletal muscle. The phenotype constrains function but does not identify a molecular activity.

recommended_action: replace with GO:0030165 PDZ domain binding
basis: All 22 recorded IntAct partners are PDZ-domain proteins (98 PDZ domains) and human ASNSD1 ends ETKL, a class I PDZ-binding motif absent from human ASNS. Qualifiers: 21 of 22 partners come from in vitro peptide assays (PMID:36115835 holdup, PMID:30126976 array), PDZK1 is the single cell-based corroboration (PMID:33961781), and the motif is primate-restricted (12/437 vertebrate orthologs carry any class I motif; mouse ends GRLQILP), so the term must not be propagated by ISS or IBA.

basis: See the GO:0005515 row. Candidate MF requiring curator verification of the IntAct lines; not core function and not transferable to non-primate orthologs.
